label: Main reading
notes: The main interpretation of every observation. In the Palynodata frame outside the occurrence tail, the strict spore set (accepted, curated and unvetted usable records; data/spores/first_appearances.csv).

label: Every live dispute resolved towards counting
notes: Adds published alternatives that remain in dispute. In the Palynodata frame, the inclusive spore set (adds doubtful records). Superseded claims never count.

label: Inclusive plus unassessed outliers
notes: Adds claims held out of the main reading by the rule for unassessed outliers (Piterophyton, the Ordos preprint). For sensitivity only.
